member.name: T:System.Storage.StorageProvider
member.summary: Opens directional byte streams at validated logical storage paths.
member.remarks: Development API after Preview 9. Implementations resolve Path in their own address space. Parsing validates syntax only; it does not grant access or establish existence. Operations are synchronous and may block. The caller closes each successful stream. This contract requires neither text helpers nor descriptor lookup. See the [provider guide](/docs/storage-provider.html).

member.name: M:System.Storage.StorageProvider.CreateNew(System.Storage.Path)

member.name: T:System.Streams.InputStream
member.summary: A synchronous input capability implemented by platform file streams and application providers. Development API after Preview 9.
member.remarks: Caller-owned arrays, partial transfers, explicit idempotent Close and typed errors. No seeking, scheduling or automatic disposal is implied. The interface does not impose native file lifetime on memory implementations.

member.name: M:System.Streams.InputStream.Read(System.Byte[],System.Int32,System.Int32)
member.summary: Attempts one synchronous partial read.
member.param: Caller-owned byte array; retained only for the duration of this call.
Maximum bytes to transfer, from zero through 65536 and within the array range.
member.returns: Ok with the transferred count, or StreamError. Closed is checked before range validation; invalid ranges and oversized requests fail before transfer.
member.remarks: Only the transferred elements change. A positive-count read returning zero indicates EOF; zero-count does not establish EOF. Calls do not suspend. No concurrency safety is promised.

member.name: M:System.Streams.InputStream.Close
member.summary: Closes this stream; repeated calls are harmless.
member.remarks: Subsequent transfers return Closed. This no-result operation does not report close failures or promise flush/durability. Other streams opened separately retain their own lifetime.

member.summary: Attempts one synchronous partial write.

member.name: T:System.Streams.FileInputStream
member.summary: A blocking, explicitly closed file read stream. Development API, not included in Preview 9.
member.remarks: Native resources belong to the invocation. Close promptly; invocation teardown closes remaining files. A retained stream cannot be reused in another invocation. There is no finalizer, automatic disposal, seeking or asynchronous scheduling in this slice.

member.name: M:System.Streams.FileInputStream.Read(System.Byte[],System.Int32,System.Int32)
member.summary: Attempts one partial read using a caller-owned byte array.

member.name: T:System.Storage.File
member.summary: The file branch of StorageItem, implemented by storage providers.
member.remarks: Development interface after Preview 9. Implementations supply Name, Path and byte operations. File has no public constructor and owns no mandatory native handle. Current operations block and return directional streams; callers close successful streams. CreateNew remains a POC address-opening operation pending alignment of creation with resolved items. Static native text helpers moved to FileText. See the [Storage guide](/docs/storage-items.html).

member.name: M:System.Storage.File.OpenRead
member.summary: Opens existing bytes for reading.
member.returns: InputStream on success, or the retained provider's StreamError unchanged.
member.remarks: Delegates to the provider with Path. The caller closes a successful stream. Opening can fail even after successful lookup. Creation never overwrites an existing entry; later write failure does not roll back creation.

member.name: M:System.Storage.File.CreateNew
member.summary: Exclusively creates an empty file for writing.
member.returns: OutputStream on success, or the retained provider's StreamError unchanged.
member.remarks: Delegates to the provider with Path. The caller closes a successful stream. Opening can fail even after successful lookup. Creation never overwrites an existing entry; later write failure does not roll back creation.

member.name: M:System.Storage.FileText.ReadAllText(System.String,System.Int32)
member.summary: Reads a bounded native file as strict UTF-8.
member.param: Native path string; provider Path parsing is not applied.
Nonnegative maximum number of bytes to read.
member.remarks: Synchronous. Opens and closes per call. Rejects non-regular files, malformed UTF-8 and contents exceeding the limit; a UTF-8 BOM is preserved as text. Zero accepts an empty file. This static helper does not use a descriptor provider.

member.name: M:System.Storage.FileText.WriteAllText(System.String,System.String,System.Int32)
member.summary: Creates or replaces a native file with bounded UTF-8 text.
member.param: Text encoded as UTF-8 without adding a BOM.
member.remarks: The exact method is documented in the [manual reference](/docs/storage-items.html#writealltext) because DocFX cannot render its unit-valued Result. Invalid limits and oversized text are rejected before modification. Later I/O failures can leave partial output; this is not atomic replacement.

member.name: T:System.Storage.StorageLookup
member.summary: A byte provider that can query a file address without retaining a stream.
member.remarks: Extends StorageProvider. GetFile returns a descriptor bound to the queried provider and logical address, or StorageLookupError. Implementations inspect current kind/existence rather than opening content. Success is an observation, not a guarantee of later access. Byte-only providers need not implement this interface.

member.name: M:System.Storage.StorageLookup.GetFile(System.Storage.Path)
member.summary: Looks up an existing file and returns its provider-bound descriptor.
member.returns: A File retaining this provider and address, or StorageLookupError such as NotFound, WrongKind, AccessDenied, InvalidPath or IoFailure.
member.remarks: Must not create the file or retain an open stream. Provider-specific aliases and concurrent changes do not establish stable item identity.

member.name: T:System.Storage.Directory
member.summary: The directory branch of StorageItem, implemented by storage providers.
member.remarks: Development interface after Preview 9. Providers supply Name, Path, child-address construction and explicit relative file lookup. There is no public constructor. Current sample implementations retain provider context; no metadata cache or native filesystem identity is required. FileAt remains a transitional POC address operation. GetItem, GetDirectory and GetItems are follow-up work, not implemented members.

member.name: M:System.Storage.Directory.FileAt(System.String)
member.summary: Constructs a direct-child file address without performing I/O.
member.param: One nonempty child name, excluding separators, dot/parent segments and other invalid Path characters.
member.returns: A File using this provider, or StorageLookupError.InvalidPath.
member.remarks: Use this for a future destination. It does not check existence, open a stream or create a file. The error family is StorageLookupError rather than the earlier sample FileReadError.

member.name: M:System.Storage.Directory.GetFile(System.String)
member.summary: Validates one child name and explicitly looks up its file.
member.param: One direct child name, not a relative path containing separators.
member.returns: A provider-bound File, InvalidPath for an invalid name, or the provider lookup error unchanged.
member.remarks: Equivalent to resolving FileAt and querying StorageLookup.GetFile; it owns no stream.

member.name: M:System.Storage.Directory.GetFile(System.Storage.Path)
member.summary: Resolves a relative logical path in this directory and looks up its file.
member.param: Relative Path; nested segments are supported, absolute inputs are rejected.
member.returns: A provider-bound File, InvalidPath for an absolute input, or the provider lookup error unchanged.
member.remarks: Dot queries this directory address as a file, normally WrongKind. Resolution preserves the provider and prefix; it does not normalize, enforce parent existence or create a security sandbox.

member.name: T:System.Storage.StorageItem
member.summary: A stored item whose two permitted interface branches are File and Directory.
member.remarks: The Raven reference metadata closes the root to File and Directory. Providers may implement those interfaces, but cannot introduce unrelated direct StorageItem branches. The compiler and strict CIL importer enforce this boundary; raw neoIL does not enforce the closed-hierarchy metadata. The implementation owns interpretation and access. Metadata queries and enumeration are planned, not implemented here.

member.name: P:System.Storage.StorageItem.Path
member.summary: Gets this item's logical address in its provider namespace.
member.remarks: Represented state, without performing a new storage query. A path alone is not authority, stable identity or a guarantee of subsequent access.

member.name: P:System.Storage.StorageItem.Name
member.summary: Gets this item's represented name without performing a storage query.
member.returns: The item name supplied by its provider implementation.

member.name: T:System.Storage.FileText
member.summary: Compatibility helpers for bounded native UTF-8 file reads and writes.
member.remarks: Development callers migrate File.ReadAllText/WriteAllText to FileText.ReadAllText/WriteAllText as File becomes an interface. Native string resolution and error behavior are unchanged; these helpers do not use StorageProvider. WriteAllText is documented in the [manual reference](/docs/storage-items.html#writealltext) because DocFX cannot render its unit-valued result.
